node.title: Principle — empower the team, never police it
node.summary: Measurement and governance land at the repo/system level — never individual keystrokes. The line between a tool developers adopt and one they route around.
node.interview_question: This is a value, not a feature. How is 'empower not police' enforced in the product rather than just promised in the deck?

competitor.name: DX (Atlassian)
competitor.positioning: Every DevEx/productivity vendor claims 'we don't surveil'; the principle only differentiates if Faros can prove enforcement where rivals only assert intent.
